# Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono

The font backup codes are shown and printed in (see `ViewBackupCodesPage`), from the Braille Institute (SIL Open Font
License 1.1, see `LICENSE`), version 5.2.5 of the `@fontsource/atkinson-hyperlegible-mono` package: its latin subset,
weight 500. It's designed so easily confused characters look different: its zero is slashed, and its capital I,
lowercase l and 1 are each distinct. It's hosted here, rather than loaded from elsewhere, as the site's
Content-Security-Policy only allows its own fonts.
